identification: Single wide (about 50-60 cm) rough-sawn pale slab about 2 m long with a knot void near the top; catalogued Huon pine. Photo shows pale straw timber with dark pin flecks, plausible Huon but could be celery-top or other pine, so ID is not certain. Gowans sells about 20-100 near-identical Huon slabs every week.
